title: ProVe: Proposer-Verifier Decoding
abstract: arXiv:2610.27815v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Speculative decoding accelerates autoregressive (AR) language models by letting a small model draft tokens serially and a large model verify them in parallel. We reverse these roles. Starting from a standard AR checkpoint, we fine-tune the large model into a proposer that predicts a block of future tokens in a single forward pass, then use one additional forward pass to verify the proposed block. This gives ProVe, Proposer-Verifier decoding. The verifier can be a smaller AR model or the proposer itself; the latter gives ProVe-lossless, which reproduces the proposer's greedy AR decoding. Block proposals already provide substantial room for acceleration: with a block size of 16, the proposed block has an average AR-matching prefix of 6.6 tokens on GSM8K. translated_abstract: 推测解码通过让小模型串行起草token、大模型并行验证来加速自回归（AR）语言模型。我们反转了这两个角色。从一个标准的AR检查点出发，我们将大模型微调为一个提议者，使其能够在单次前向传播中预测未来的一个token块，然后用一次额外的前向传播来验证所提议的块。这就是ProVe，即提议者-验证者解码。验证者可以是一个较小的AR模型，也可以是提议者本身；后者构成ProVe-lossless，它能够复现提议者的贪婪AR解码结果。块提议本身已经提供了可观的加速空间：当块大小为16时，在GSM8K上提议块与AR解码的平均匹配前缀达到6.6个token。在六个基准测试上，使用32B提议者，ProVe-lossless无需训练单独的草稿头即可达到平均2.5倍的AR吞吐量。使用较小的3B验证器时，ProVe达到平均2.7倍的吞吐量。
tldr: ProVe反转了推测解码中提议者与验证者的角色，让大模型通过单次前向传播直接提议token块并加以验证，无需训练独立草稿头即可实现2.5-2.7倍推理加速，且无损版本能完全复现原始贪婪解码结果。
en_tdlr: ProVe reverses the roles in speculative decoding by having a large model propose token blocks in a single forward pass and verify them, achieving 2.5-2.7x inference speedup without training a separate draft head, with its lossless variant exactly reproducing greedy AR decoding.
